required_review_dimensions.description: Exact valid Slice6 authorization receipt and exact request lineage remain required.
Current external authority and now_epoch are validated at actual terminal use time; revoked/expired/not-yet-valid/replaced authority fails closed.
Current authority snapshot is self-hash bound and exactly matches authority id plus project/task/effect/action/artifact/state-version.
Current authoritative project/state/artifact match immediately before terminal execution.
Adapter recover/execute_once protocol durably maps one execution identity to one exact binding/result and rejects rebinding.
A durable adapter side effect followed by crash before local completion is recovered without duplicate effect.
Crash after local completion before response recovers without duplicate effect.
Concurrent identical requests converge to one adapter side effect/result.
Only LOCAL_REFERENCE_APPLIED is a success marker; structured FAILED/malformed/widened adapter results cannot mint completion.
Adapter exception/self-report cannot widen authority or create successful completion.
Completion binds receipt hash, authority snapshot hash, exact lineage, adapter result digest, and deterministic completion hash.
Model, worker, reviewer, CI, and conversation state cannot replace current authority or side-effect evidence.
No successful result claims real production merge/release/deploy/completion.
Accepted Slice1→6 authority boundaries remain preserved.
Adversarial review finds no remaining false-green/stale-authority/idempotency/failure-laundering/crash bypass within scope.
